name: worm-print-platform
description: 跨框架可视化打印模板设计器（Web Components）+ 表达式引擎 + 同构渲染管线 + 渲染微服务 + 静默打印客户端（开源 monorepo）

scripts.predev:render: npm install && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/echarts
scripts.predev:client: npm install && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/contract && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/mcp && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/echarts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/contract && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/mcp && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/echarts && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/render && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/client && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/skills && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/marketplace && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-echarts && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-data-preview
scripts.test: npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/contract && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/mcp && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/echarts && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/client && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/render && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/skills && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/marketplace && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-echarts && npm run test -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-data-preview
scripts.pack:client:dir: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/contract && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/mcp && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/echarts && npm run pack:dir -w @worm-print-platform/client
scripts.pack:client:prepare: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/contract && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/mcp && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/echarts && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/client
scripts.pack:client: npm run pack:client:prepare && npm exec -w @worm-print-platform/client -- electron-builder --mac --win
scripts.pack:client:mac: npm run pack:client:prepare && npm exec -w @worm-print-platform/client -- electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:client:win: npm run pack:client:prepare && npm exec -w @worm-print-platform/client -- electron-builder --win
scripts.pack:client:linux:native: npm run pack:client:prepare && npm exec -w @worm-print-platform/client -- electron-builder --linux
scripts.publish:local: npm run build && npm -w @worm-print-platform/core exec yalc push
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/core --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/canvas --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/echarts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/skills --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/marketplace --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-echarts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build && npm test && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/core --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/canvas --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/echarts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/skills --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/marketplace --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-echarts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public --dry-run
scripts.publish:canvas: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/canvas --tag latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && node scripts/check-canvas-dist-tag.mjs
scripts.publish:canvas:beta: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/canvas --tag next --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && node scripts/check-canvas-dist-tag.mjs --fix
scripts.publish:canvas:dry-run: npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/plugin-kit && npm run build -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/core && npm test -w @worm-print-platform/canvas && npm publish -w @worm-print-platform/canvas --dry-run --tag latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --access public && node scripts/check-canvas-dist-tag.mjs --warn-only
